newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe extends surge after debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe extends surge after debt deal.

text.p: Polish builder Espebepe SA surged 9.4 percent to 8.15 zlotys, extending Monday's 9.6-percent jump after creditors on Friday accepted the company's version of a debt-relief deal, traders said.
Espebepe trade was suspended on Tuesday after the firm erringly reported earnings data.
"The stock will probably rise again tomorrow but there could soon be profit-taking by those who bought expecting the agreement with creditors," one trader said.
The agreement envisages an 80-percent write-off of the firm's 75-million-zloty debt.
Buying of the stock was strong enough after price fixing on Wednesday for investors to have their bids reduced.
